info.title: Corpus API
info.description: The HTTP surface of a Corpus workspace server. Generated from the `@hono/zod-openapi` route definitions in `packages/contract` — regenerate with `npm run generate -w packages/contract` rather than editing this document. Plugin routes mount under `/api/x/<plugin>/...` and are discovered at runtime, so they are deliberately absent here (SPEC.md §10).
